text:
```yaml
name: Check Discord Link

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */12 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check-link:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '16'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Validate Discord link
      id: validate_link
      run: |
        curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "https://discord.gg/f2AjwV2AN"
      env:
        DISCORD_LINK: ${{ secrets.DISCORD_LINK }}

    - name: Create issue if link is invalid
      if: steps.validate_link.outputs.exit_code != '200'
      run: |
        gh issue create --title "Invalid Discord Link" --body "The Discord link provided in the README and TUI footer is invalid. Please update it to the correct link." --label "discord-link"
```
